scripts.name: Blacksmithy Trainer
scripts.author: 3HMonkey
scripts.description: Trains Blacksmithy from 35 to 120 by crafting the best item for your current skill, with a live window: resource counter, progress, statistics, optional smelting of what it makes, restocking from a container and self-crafted hammers.

scripts.name: Config Example
scripts.author: 3HMonkey
scripts.description: Shows the whole Config API: defaults, loading, saving, nested tables, Exists and Delete. Run it a few times and watch the values survive restarts.

scripts.name: Loot Organizer
scripts.author: 3HMonkey
scripts.description: Sorts the contents of any container (a corpse, a loot bag or your backpack) into destination containers assigned per category through the script window. Optional item identification and good-loot routing; settings persist via the Config API.

scripts.name: Magery Trainer
scripts.author: 3HMonkey
scripts.description: Trains Magery from 30 to 100 by casting the cheapest spell that still gains, meditates when mana runs out and optionally restocks exactly the reagents the current spell needs from a container.

scripts.name: Musicianship Trainer
scripts.author: 3HMonkey
scripts.description: Picks the best instrument from your backpack (priority list like the classic UOSteam macro) and plays it until the target skill is reached. Re-finds the next instrument automatically when one breaks.

scripts.name: Stealth and Hiding Trainer
scripts.author: 3HMonkey
scripts.description: Trains Stealth by travelling through a moongate and stealthing after every trip, rotating through all destinations. Can train Hiding to 80 first and equips a ringmail tunic and sleeves from 80 Stealth on. Target values are set in variables at the top of the script.

scripts.name: UI Example - Advanced
scripts.author: 3HMonkey
scripts.description: A character dashboard that uses every script-UI control: live progress bars, sliders, text input, rows, visibility toggles and settings that persist via the Config API.

scripts.name: UI Example - Simple
scripts.author: 3HMonkey
scripts.description: The smallest useful script window: labels, a live-updating label, a button callback and a checkbox.
